description: This file defines an abstract base class 'HTMLPurifier_Node' for representing nodes in an HTML purification library. It includes properties for tracking source line/column, exempt processing, and dead nodes, along with an abstract method for token conversion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Node
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for all node types in the HTML Purifier system, providing properties for source tracking, exemption rules, and node status, and requiring subclasses to implement the toTokenPair() method.

methods.name: toTokenPair
methods.description: An abstract method intended to return a pair of start and end tokens representing the node, excluding children. Implementation is required in subclasses.
